_comments: ActivitySyncRunDetail can hold encrypted fragments of messages deliberately NOT ingested.
Field-Level Security (EnableFieldLevelSecurity = true) is enabled on this entity:
UI role has CanRead = 1 so operators can inspect sync run decision metadata (Decision,
DecidedByStage, Reason, Confidence), while EntityFieldPermission denies CapturedContent,
EncryptionKeyID, and EncryptionKey to every role except Developer (DEAFCCEC-6A37-EF11-86D4-000D3A4E707E).
Integration keeps CanCreate so a scheduled ingest can append audit rows; CanRead/Update/Delete stay 0.
Host-side EntityFieldPermission rows are seeded by V202611031200__v5.59.x__Activity_Sync_Run_Detail_And_Activity_Access.sql.
